programme.desc: Crime drama with Kellie Martin. A couple accused of a murder go on the run, leaving their baby with bookshop owner and amateur sleuth Samantha Kinsey. Can she look after the child and solve the case?

programme.title: The Colt
programme.desc: In 1864, an American Civil War troop struggles to survive when young Union (American Civil War) soldier Jim Rabb (Ryan Merriman) discovers that his mare has given birth to a Colt (horse). A superior officer orders Jim to shoot the foal because it may become a burden, but Jim - seeing the colt as a sign of hope and a reminder of the beauty of life - refuses. The colt remains with the men as they battle. When Confederacy (American Civil War)s overtake the camp and steal the colt, Jim must risk his life retrieving it.

programme.title: Audrey's Rain
programme.desc: Heart-warming drama about a bitter, sharp-tongued spinster, whose future looks bleakwhen she is saddled with raising her nephew and niece after her sister commits suicide. Audrey resents that her family has robbed her of a life of her own, but when her childhood sweetheart reappears on the scene, her life takes an unexpected turn.

programme.title: Acceptance
programme.desc: Paul confesses his feelings to Rosanna. He gets Rosanna to admit to her feelings for him but she insists she cant think about anything but Cabots welfare for now. She agrees to leave the door open between them. Meanwhile, Barbara goes to James to let him know that his plan for Jordan and Rosanna is falling apart. She indirectly asks James for his help in making sure Jordan and Rosanna stay together. Soon after, Cabot mysteriously appears in the middle of Fairwinds, when neither Paul nor Rosanna put him there! A new clue appears in the paper and Chris, Alison, Emily and Susan are all trying to figure it out. When Nancy cant help, Alison goes to Aaron. He agrees to help her, and Alison doesnt tell him about her engagement. Meanwhile, Bob helps Chris with the clue. Chris hurries to the dance studio where the key is apparently hidden and finds a tango lesson underway. Emily and Chris agree to take a tango lesson in order to get to the key. They are dancing together when Alison and Aaron arrive outside. Alison is about to go in when Aaron notices her ring. Tom confronts Margo about the compact and she tells him its not hers. Tom asks her one more time if it was only a kiss between her and Doc. Margo confirms the lie and they agree to try to move on. Jill has overheard everything. She confronts Margo after Tom leaves, promising to keep quiet about what she has witnessed on one condition. Meanwhile, Ben tells Jessica hell agree to in Vitro. At the hospital, Jessica bumps into Doc and admits shes been too hard on him. Then Dr. Schilling informs her she isnt a candidate for in vitro because shes already pregnant! Doc looks on as Ben hugs Jessica to celebrate the good news.

programme.title: Monte Walsh
programme.desc: Montelius "Monte" Walsh (Tom Selleck) is an aging cowboy facing the final days of the Wild West era. He and his friend Chet Rollins (Keith Carradine), another long-time cowhand, work at whatever ranch work comes their way, but "nothing they can't do from a horse". Their lives are divided between months on the range and the occasional trip into town. Camaraderie and competition with the other cowboys fill their days. They seek work and take a job at the ranch of Cal Brennan (William Devane), where they meet an old friend, Shorty Austin (George Eads), another ranch hand.

programme.title: Blackbeard
programme.desc: Action-packed historical drama starring Angus Macfadyen as the fearsome English pirate of the early 18th century known as Blackbeard. Lieutenant Robert Maynard is sent from Great Britain to the seas surrounding the West Indies. His mission is to destroy an infamous pirate ship, known as The Queen Anne's Revenge, and to put an end to its villainous crew including the ill-famed Blackbeard. Also starring Mark Umbers and Jessica Chastain.

programme.title: Casanova
programme.desc: He was the world's most notorious seducer. A swashbuckler, master of disguise and wit - it was said no woman could resist Casanova's amorous charms. Until now. For the first time in his life, the legendary Casanova (Heath Ledger) is about to meet his match with an alluring Ventian beauty, Francesca (Sienna Miller), who does the one thing he never thought possible: refuse him. Through a series of clever disguises and scheming ruses, he manages to get ever closer to Francesca. But he is playing the most dangerous game he has ever encountered - one that will risk not only his life and reputation, but his only chance at true passion.

programme.title: Wyvern
programme.desc: The small Alaskan town of Beaver Mills is located just north of the Arctic Circle, meaning that the sun does not set during the summer solstice. As the town prepares for its annual celebration of this event, a wyvern is awakened by the melting of the ice caps, and attacks a fisherman. Jake (Nick Chinlund), a handyman fixing the cafe where a waitress named Claire (Erin Karpluk) works, hurts his hand and David (David Lewis (Canadian actor)), the town's doctor, examines it. While driving back to town, David is attacked by the wyvern. The next morning, Sheriff Dawson (John Shaw) and Jake hear gunshots and find Haas (Barry Corbin), a redneck attacked by the wyvern. Colonel (Don S. Davis), who has seen the Wyvern, goes to town to warn the citizens; but they disbelieve him, and he goes to kill it. Dawson radios to his Deputy Susie (Elaine Miles) to watch the town, but fails to convey his meaning. Dawson finds his friend dead, and returns. At the town, the wyvern kills Susie and several other people. Jake, Claire, Haas, and the eccentric Edna (Karen Austin) take shelter in the cafe. Later, Vinyl (Tinsel Korey), who runs the town's radio, and Farley (Simon Longmore), another citizen, hide in the cafe. Sheriff Dawson is killed by the wyvern. Jake and Claire track the wyvern into the woods, where they find the Colonel, and discover the wyvern is killing anyone on the Interstate. Farley is injured trying to get supplies. The wyvern then uses David, still alive, as bait to draw people from the cafe. Jake goes to rescue him, and Farley distracts the wyvern to save them, but is eaten. David tells the group the Wyvern has eggs, and dies of his injuries. The survivors decide to electrify the nest, but the wyvern kills Haas. Jake takes a truck left on the side of the road and, using the eggs as bait, kills the wyvern. Jake, Claire, Colonel, Vinyl, and Edna try again to radio for help.

Rude police chief Connors isn't up to an investigation while the killer keeps sniping, so the bookstore's armchair sleuths duo does it alone, starting from a lacquered box left by Jim for his illegitimate daughter, who never even knew his name. It starts a set of cues, slowly unraveling a grim intrigue starting during a 1965 US illegal intrusion into Red Khmer territory.

programme.title: The Colour of Magic
programme.desc: Constantly failing at the Unseen University, the wizard Rincewind is given the task by the Patrician of looking after the Discworld's first tourist: Twoflower. The main character is the incompetent and cynical wizard Rincewind, who involuntarily finds himself as a guide to the naive tourist, Twoflower. After they are forced to flee from the city of Ankh-Morpork after a terrible fire they are sent on a journey across the disc which is unknowingly being controlled by a board game being played by the Gods. They meet two barbarians on their way out of morpork, Bravd and Weasel. After their visit to Wyrmberg, the upside-down mountain which is home to dragons that only exist in the imagination, their journey leads them to the country of Krull, perched on the very edge of the Discworld where they are thrown off the edge of the Disc due to the Krullian's urge to find out the gender of Great A'Tuin (the turtle which is swimming through space with four elephants resting the Disc on top).

programme.title: Henry VIII: Man, Monarch, Monster
programme.desc: The opening episode sees our experts examine how Henry VIII's traumatic childhood affected his personality – from the death of his older brother, which made him heir to the throne of England, to the tragic early death of his beloved mother. The effect of her death on Henry is dramatically revealed in a recent discovery of an extraordinary, illustrated manuscript portraying the young prince weeping inconsolably over her loss. Henry's complex relationship with his controlling father – Henry VII – is explored as he kept the teenage Henry as a virtual prisoner, passing on his own paranoia that would mark his son's personality for the rest of his life. As soon as his father dies and Henry becomes King Henry VIII, he brutally executes his father's closest advisors and issues a public proclamation criticising the old King's reign. Alongside death and fraught family relationships, this episode charts the extraordinary rise of Cardinal Wolsey – the son of a commoner who rises ruthlessly through the court to become Henry's chief advisor and closest friend. With exclusive access to the archives of the Vatican Library, Tudor expert Dr Tracy Borman analyses an account from a foreign ambassador, which has never appeared on camera before – it reveals Wolsey's expertise in manipulating Henry and includes incredible detail about their complex personal relationship. Their friendship unravels however, when Wolsey fails to get Henry's divorce agreed so he can marry Anne Boleyn and Wolsey falls from Henry's grace as quickly as he rose. Strange quirks begin to appear in Henry's personality. He becomes obsessed with the problem that would dominate his reign – his lack of a male heir – and he becomes increasingly controlling, developing an unnerving habit of avoiding direct eye contact with others. In his rise to power, Henry has transformed from an anxious prince into a powerful monarch completely convinced of his own supremacy – but in the process, he will plunge the country into chaos.

programme.title: Henry VIII: Man, Monarch, Monster
programme.desc: This episode takes viewers on a journey of marriage, affairs and tyrannical politics. It explores how Henry's obsession with marrying Anne Boleyn results in a cataclysmic and hugely unpopular split with the Roman Catholic Church, while his relationship with Anne turns from infatuation to deadly hatred. Tudor expert Dr Tracy Borman reveals the true nature of Henry's early infatuation when she visits the archives of the Vatican Library in Rome to catch a privileged glimpse of Henry's love letters to Anne. Henry also has a secret weapon, his new chief advisor and enforcer – Thomas Cromwell – who personally oversees the plunder and destruction of Catholic monasteries across the land. But, Henry's behaviour is becoming increasingly paranoid and tyrannical. Historian Dr Robert Hutchinson visits the Parliamentary Archives to see the legal document – The Treason Act – that turned Tudor England into a virtual dictatorship under Henry. He also examines a striking contemporary diary entry, which reveals that a jousting injury probably caused Henry to have a traumatic brain injury, making him irritable and suspicious of everyone around him. After the accident, Henry's court becomes a nest of vipers where no one is safe, particularly Anne Boleyn and Thomas Cromwell, who bear the brunt of the King's increasingly unhinged behaviour. Desperate to save his own neck, Thomas Cromwell plots against Anne, finding 'evidence' that she had an affair behind Henry's back with not one but five men. Anne is found guilty of treason and executed. Thomas Cromwell has out manoeuvred her, and Henry has got what he wanted – the chance for a new wife and a male heir.

programme.title: End of Days
programme.desc: Bodyguard Jericho Cane stumbles across a demonic state of affairs when he prevents the assassination of his Wall Street employer. It transpires that Cane's boss is Satan himself, come to impregnate a woman on the eve of the new millennium and so bring about the end of days foretold in the Book of Revelation. With the help of his partner, Chicago, Cane now attempts to protect Christine from both Satan and a group of priests who believe that her death is the only way to halt Armageddon.

Along the way Marco and Grace seem to find a mutual attraction for each other.

programme.title: Due East
programme.desc: A smart, hardworking high school senior has been an outsider for almost 4 years. When a fellow loner moves to Due East, she finds herself in a relationship for the first time, leading to a small town scandal that changes her life forever.

programme.title: The Outsider
programme.desc: An investigation of a dead daughter begins when a military contractor Lex Walker (Craig Fairbrass) arrives in Los Angeles and he finds the body is not his daughter's. Lex Walker, a British mercenary battling in Afghanistan who drops everything to hurry to Los Angeles when he is informed that his daughter Samantha, who he has not seen in many years, has been found dead. When he arrives at the morgue to identify the body, he is for some reason unsurprised to discover that it is not hers. So he begins a one-man investigation into her whereabouts, trailed by the suspicious detective (Jason Patric) assigned to the case. He soon makes his way to Samantha's boss, Karl Schuster (James Caan), the millionaire CEO of a high-tech company who offers sympathy but little help. It quickly becomes obvious that Schuster is hiding something, since he displays no hesitation about shooting one of his henchmen to death in his own office. Aided by a sexy barmaid (Shannon Elizabeth) enticed by his offer of a $10,000 finder's fee, the take-no-prisoners Lex sets out getting to the bottom of the mystery, beating up or shooting the myriad human obstacles who get in his way. It all leads to his discovery of a massive identity-theft scheme engineered by Schuster about which Lex's very much alive daughter (Melissa Ordway) has the goods.

programme.title: Breaking Through
programme.desc: Patsy McCartle is a widow with two sons trying to gather all the money she has to pay for her car, bills, and her son's medication, all of which she can barely afford. Patsy then turns to dealing drugs and becomes addicted to crystal meth. Her only way of recovery rests in the hands of her children.

programme.title: Annie's Point
programme.desc: Richard Eason is flat-out filling his late father's shoes as CEO of an east Coast real estate developing company, so he can't spend nearly as much time with mother Annie and daughter Ella as they would like. Annie is dead-set on visiting a place in California where she and her late husband hoped to build their dream house and convinces Ella, who wants to drop out of school and aspires a singing career, to drive along. Ill-prepared but tempestuously stubborn, they embark on an adventurous road trip, where Ella meets hunky waiter Scott Tardy. Learning Annie needs surgery soon, Richard gives chase.

programme.title: Dinotopia
programme.desc: Based loosely on the novels by James Gurney, Dinotopia is a fantasy adventure series following two young brothers who wash up on the shore of the titular island, a magical lost paradise where humans and dinosaurs live together. Karl and David Scott are half-brothers enjoying a flight with their father on his private aircraft when tragedy strikes and the plane crashes to the ground. When they wash up on land, their adventure begins, learning about this hidden civilisation and begin to adjust to their surroundings. The three-episode show aired in 2002, starring Wentworth Miller, Tyron Leitso, and David Thewlis.

programme.title: Archangel
programme.desc: Drama, with Daniel Craig. A British professor working in Russia investigates mysteries concerning the life and death of Joseph Stalin.

programme.desc: Vittorio Innocente, a young man, estranged from the tragedies of his Italian immigrant family, has spent his adult life denying his past. programme.title: Good Fences
programme.desc: Good Fences is about an upwardly-mobile Black family for whom the American dream becomes a nightmare. In the 1970s, Tom Spader is an attorney who is determined to end what he has dubbed "the colored man's losing streak." When his winning of a high-profile case thrusts him into the limelight, he decides to move his wife and their two kids out of their mixed lower-middle-class town and into the posh enclave of Greenwich, Connecticut.

programme.title: The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon
programme.desc: In The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon, Daryl (Noman Reedus) washes ashore in France and struggles to piece together how he got there and why. The series tracks his journey across a broken but resilient France as he hopes to find a way back home. As he makes the journey, though, the connections he forms along the way complicate his ultimate plan.

programme.title: LaLiga. "Racing" - "Villarreal"
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Ligue 1. Marseille - Strasbourg
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?".

programme.title: Greatest Mysteries with Laurence Fishburne
programme.desc: Investigate a wide range of historically compelling topics and the mysteries surrounding each including the Titanic, D.B. Cooper, Roswell, John Wilkes Booth, and more. Each program within the franchise will showcase fresh, new evidence and perspectives including never-before-released documents to the general public, personal diaries and DNA evidence to unearth brand-new information about these infamous and enigmatic chapters in history.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: A&E presents the new original real-life series "Storage Wars," which follows professional buyers and their teams as they scour repossessed storage units in search of hidden treasure. Part gamblers, part detectives, these auction pros have found everything from coffins to the world's most valuable comic book collection, paying as little as ten dollars for items valued in the millions. Each episode of "Storage Wars" follows a group of bidders as they get a quick peek inside the units, aided only by the beam of a flashlight. They then must assess on the spot if the unit is worth a bid and how high they will actually go to grasp the gold. The high-stakes fun begins as we see if the resulting buy is full of mostly trash... or true treasure. Driven by Dan Dotson, one of the most successful and outrageous auctioneers in the country, the cast of buyers is as colorful and varied as the treasures they uncover.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Over 10,000 crop circles have been reported worldwide, appearing in 50 different countries, and nearly every continent on Earth. These strange designs pressed into crop fields range from simple circles to elaborate pictograms thousand of feet long. The phenomenon has been associated with scientific anomalies, strange lights, and even UFO activity. But critics say that they are all part of an elaborate hoax. But are they? Crop circles have been making modern headlines since the 1960's, but their history can be traced back hundreds--if not thousands of years. The designs themselves often contain encrypted messages and complex mathematical, geometric, and astronomical equations that perplex our top mathematicians and scientists. Ancient Astronaut Theorist, Giorgio Tsoukalos travels to England to meet with researchers and scientists to investigate the phenomenon both on the ground and in the lab to find out what we haven't been told.

Each two-hour episode follows Rick Harrison, Corey Harrison and Austin "Chumlee" Russell as they step out of the World Famous Gold & Silver Pawn Shop in Las Vegas to connect with fans in eight different cities and acquire some of the most remarkable items imaginable.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: History's Greatest Warriors
programme.desc: The Japanese samurai is master of both military strategy and combat skills, honed through rigorous training in weapons like the katana and Yumi. Guided by the code of Bushido, the samurai warrior combines fierce discipline with loyalty and honour.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Over 10,000 crop circles have been reported worldwide, appearing in 50 different countries, and nearly every continent on Earth. These strange designs pressed into crop fields range from simple circles to elaborate pictograms thousand of feet long. The phenomenon has been associated with scientific anomalies, strange lights, and even UFO activity. But critics say that they are all part of an elaborate hoax. But are they? Crop circles have been making modern headlines since the 1960's, but their history can be traced back hundreds--if not thousands of years. The designs themselves often contain encrypted messages and complex mathematical, geometric, and astronomical equations that perplex our top mathematicians and scientists. Ancient Astronaut Theorist, Giorgio Tsoukalos travels to England to meet with researchers and scientists to investigate the phenomenon both on the ground and in the lab to find out what we haven't been told.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?".

programme.title: The Curse of Oak Island
programme.desc: For over two centuries, teams of searchers, including Franklin D. Roosevelt, have attempted to crack the code that will unearth the treasure believed to be buried on the small island off the coast of Nova Scotia. Armed with the knowledge of those that came before them, the muscle of heavy machinery and decades of engineering know-how, brothers Rick and Marty Lagina and their partners may be closer than anyone in history to finding the treasure that has so far claimed the lives of six men.

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

programme.title: Caught in the Act
programme.desc: Caught in the Act is a television show presenting a collection of remarkable and unexpected animal behavior caught on film, from amazing maternal instincts, to dramatic fights, rescues and competition. programme.title: Big Cat Week
programme.desc: RUSSIA'S WILD TIGER records the battle for survival of the big cats and reveals intimate details of their lives. The animals they prey on are also in the film: tigers couldn't survive without sika deer, Altai wapiti, wild boars and Asian black bears. A young tiger, born in a conservation area, will guide the viewer through the film. RUSSIA'S WILD TIGER accompanies him throughout the year after he leaves his mother. His search for a territory reveals the problems facing tigers in Russia's Far East, and the conflicts that arise when he strays into human settlements. The young tiger takes the viewer to places where the fate of Siberian tigers will be decided: vast forests, remote villages and the cities at the edge of the wilderness.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol clan gets to work on creating Beth's dream garden. To beat the incoming rainstorm, an exhausted Ben works around the clock to finish building the garden's pond and waterfall. Noticing her brother is near his breaking point, Beth plans a special surprise to lift his spirits.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's winter on the farm, and the Pol's are adding to their flock! The family is bringing in four merino ewes that were recently bred, which means with any luck the farm could be expecting its first lambs come springtime. And as winter fades into spring, the Pol's prepare for the new arrivals by building a lambing pen. Meanwhile, Beth checks if her bees survived the winter.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: The Kalahari. Land of great thirst. Endless mirages of red and yellow sand merge with a shimmering horizon. Summer rains bring brief explosions of life, painting the landscape in vibrant colours, only to be soaked up by the thirsty earth and returned once again to the desert. In this place of immense beauty, wonder and contrast all that live here are gifted with unique adaptations in order to survive.

programme.title: Battle Of the Swamp Dragons
programme.desc: South Florida is the only place on Earth that is home to both the American alligator and the American crocodile (and most recently, the Nile crocodile). But who is the baddest Florida predator? In this croc vs. gator fest, we'll compare the physical characteristics and behavior of these two prehistoric titans in the beautiful backdrop of South Florida to find out who is the true Lord of the Swamp… and identify one species that may threaten his throne.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Instead of providing in-depth examinations of the fauna of the continent of Africa, this nature series alternatively focuses on the hostile and unforgiving landscapes that the animals have to survive in. Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

programme.title: Croc Wars: Grumeti Vs Mara
programme.desc: Each year, nearly two million wildebeest and zebra cross the Serengeti on a quest for fresh grazing. But two legendary rivers stand in their way—the Grumeti and the Mara—each ruled by a formidable dynasty of Nile crocodiles. In "Croc Wars," follow these ancient predators as they prepare for the feast of the year, but not all crocodiles are created equal. In the deep, fast waters of the Mara, privilege reigns, kills come easy, and food is plentiful. In the rugged Grumeti, crocodiles must outwit, adapt and fight for every scrap. From brutal ambushes to stolen kills, this is a high-stakes battle for survival on two rivers with two strategies and only one chance to eat.

programme.title: Crocodile - Australia's Greatest Survivor
programme.desc: In Australia, dominant saltwater crocodiles, called ""boss crocs," are the largest and most powerful animals on the continent. Even after unrelenting human pressure on their very survival, they are still the masters of their world. Over the last 200 years, the impact of human activities—such as commercial hunting, agriculture and population growth—pushed them to the brink of extinction. Today, these "boss crocs" have continued to not only survive but thrive.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: On this special episode of "The Incredible Dr. Pol," Michigan's most trusted vets are always on call, because animal emergencies don't wait for business hours. From a cat attacked by a raccoon to a pig struggling with farrowing, the team tackles a wide range of urgent cases — Dr. Pol even heeds the call for a dangerously distressed horse and saves a Chihuahua's vision after a scuffle. With animals in need at all hours, these vets spring into action, improvising and solving problems on the fly. No matter the crisis, Dr. Pol and his dedicated team race to the scene, delivering lifesaving care to animals big and small.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: In this special episode, the team at Pol Vet treats beloved family companions. Kilo the dog needs a delicate eye surgery to restore his vision, Ziggy the cat suffers from a severe urinary obstruction, and Jack the horse faces a dangerous throat blockage that quickly gets messy. Meanwhile, Dr. Brenda hopes to uncover why Murphy, a friendly lab, has suddenly stopped eating, and Dr. Pol works quickly to trim the nails and beaks of two lively macaws. Whether they have fur, feathers or hooves, animals are a big part of the Pol family, both at home and in the clinic.

programme.title: Desert Lions: Surviving At Skeleton Coast
programme.desc: In this true story, lion researcher Dr. Philip Stander follows three orphaned lion cubs from birth to adulthood as they navigate the complexity of survival in one of the world's most unforgiving environments, Namibia's deadly Skeleton Coast. He gets up close and personal to unlock secrets of their world and witness the amazing adaptability of these special cats.

programme.title: Eternal Enemies: Lions And Hyenas (Revealed)
programme.desc: The Joubert's Emmy winning film is back with stunning remastered footage. Propelled by Jeremy Irons gripping narration, Eternal Enemies reveals the story of conflict between lions and hyenas, relatively unknown or even suspected in the scientific world before this. The intense relationship and enduring rivalry between the two species play out in a battle of survival. Narrated by Jeremy Irons.

programme.desc: Each year, nearly two million wildebeest and zebra cross the Serengeti on a quest for fresh grazing. But two legendary rivers stand in their way—the Grumeti and the Mara—each ruled by a formidable dynasty of Nile crocodiles. In "Croc Wars," follow these ancient predators as they prepare for the feast of the year, but not all crocodiles are created equal. In the deep, fast waters of the Mara, privilege reigns, kills come easy, and food is plentiful. In the rugged Grumeti, crocodiles must outwit, adapt and fight for every scrap. From brutal ambushes to stolen kills, this is a high-stakes battle for survival on two rivers with two strategies and only one chance to eat.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's need to break ground for a new outbuilding that will house incoming livestock and Charles has dreamt up an outrageous idea of what that structure can be - and it just may be just crazy enough to work. At the auction, the Pol's are hoping to purchase sheep and cows, but the skyrocketing bids threaten their big plans.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's been a year of farming for the Pol family. Even with Charles recovering from his injury, the farm's showing no signs of slowing down! Beth takes the next step with her bees to grow the colony and harvest honey. Charles and Ben come up with a final fix for the sheep hut's drainage problem. The whole family comes together to plant the garden and celebrate a successful year on the farm.

programme.title: Secret Life of Predators
programme.desc: There are still places on Earth where fields of grass stretch as far as the eye can see. In order to survive in these open spaces, predators must hide in plain sight. Cheetahs and secretary birds must conquer extreme heat and elusive prey, risking their lives to feed their offspring. Mongolian wolves hunt for scarce food on the steppe.

programme.title: Secret Life of Predators
programme.desc: Secret Life of Predators is a National Geography documentary series narrated by Boone Smith, exploring animals that are on the top of the food chains in the environments they inhabit, such as eagles, tigers and bears. programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Its starting to look like winter in Michigan. The cold weather doesnt stop Dr. Brenda from responding to an afterhours farm call to treat a down cow. Dr. Pol helps a German Shepherd that is in pain after eating cooked bones. Dr. Lisa uses a portable ultrasound to pregnancy check a highland cow, and Dr. Nicole staples a wound hidden under an Aussiedoodles thick fur. During breaks in the cases, Dr. Lisa leaves the clinic to go cross country skiing, and the Pol family gathers to go sledding.

programme.title: Serengeti Speed Queen
programme.desc: Nzuri is the Speed Queen of the Serengeti - but being fast isn't enough. She's constantly bullied by hyenas on the grassland and hunted by lions in the marsh. When two of her cubs are killed, the family is exiled to the transition forest. There, she learns to adapt her hunting methods and adds strategy to speed in order to outwit her enemies and steer her remaining cubs successfully to adulthood.

programme.title: Tiger Queen of Taru
programme.desc: The story of Maya the tigress plays out in a tiger reserve in Tadoba, Central India. Here, Bengal tigers chase wild dogs, fight sloth bears and feud among themselves over bloodlines and territory in never-before seen footage. Maya writes her own rules when it comes to raising a litter, yet motherhood doesn't come easy. One thing is clear, Maya will do whatever it takes to secure her bloodline within the Kingdom of Taru.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's rush to prepare for their farm's first Michigan winter. The family goes into hyperdrive to fix the pasture fence and finish building the garden hardscape before the first snow falls. Beth is worried about the bees, so she brings in some expert help to hopefully ensure their survival.

programme.title: Wild India
programme.desc: At first glance the desert of India's north-west appear devoid of life. But even in the most hostile environments wildlife thrives. In this inhospitable place, only the best adapted survive. Here, in the harsh deserts and salty drylands, live India's specialists. They have to endure extreme hardship, sandstorms, droughts, and intense heat.

programme.title: Underdogs
programme.desc: Ryan shares his distinct take on the underdogs using gross-out tactics to win the game of life. With manatees using flatulence to control their buoyancy to cave-dwelling fungus gnats creating beautifully illuminated flytraps with mucus from their butts, these underdogs are out to prove who may be the grossest survivor of them all.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bees
programme.desc: National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory explores the extraordinary lives of bees — among the planet's most important animals. Over three years, special cameras opened a rare window into a single hive, revealing their hidden world. But with more than 20,000 bee species pollinating one-third of the world's food, this series uncovers their astonishing architecture and intelligence, unlocking their secrets.

programme.title: Wild India
programme.desc: Secreted away in the shadow of the Himalayas, along the banks of the Brahmaputra River, roam One-Horned Rhinoceroses, Wild Buffalo and Asian Elephants. The last great herds of India's giant grazers. It is January, and six months of drought, fire and flood lay ahead of them. Seen through the eyes of a newborn elephant calf, this film portrays a land of unexpected contrasts and endless variety, unique to India and the world.

programme.title: Wild India
programme.desc: This is the real story of the jungles made famous in Rudyard Kipling's 'Jungle Book'. This is a world that knows nothing of compassion or kindness, dominated by two of the world's top predators, the Bengal Tiger and the Indian Wild Dog or Dhole. Kipling's Jungle Book was fiction. This is hard fact and a story that rewrites itself every year.

programme.desc: Confronted by fire, famine, predators, and poachers, three elephant families overcome adversity in ways that feel almost human in nature. This documentary will follow the journeys of elephant herds in Kenya, India, and Mali as they migrate towards food and safety, using knowledge shared over generations. As we look into the minds of elephants, we see that their unique abilities to communicate, educate, and sympathize provide them with the necessary skills to survive. Yet, despite the strength and intelligence of these majestic creatures, humans are causing elephant populations to plummet around the world.

programme.title: Amur Tiger: Secret Kingdom
programme.desc: Using a combination of remote cameras, long lens and drone filming, and told across the seasons, the Secret Kingdom of the Amur Tiger takes you deep inside this remote kingdom to unveil long held secrets about these shy and elusive hunters; how they navigate and co-exist along secret corridors, use secret messaging to communicate to one another, hunt their prey and exploit the seasons, with the ultimate ambition of finding a partner and bringing new life in to this world.

programme.title: Ark of Stone - The Voyage of Sardinia
programme.desc: No other body of water on the globe has seen a mixing of climates and ocean currents, eco-systems, peoples, cultures, ideas and genes as intense, continuous and massive as the coasts and islands of the Mediterranean. Over 40 million years ago, Sardinia broke away from Europe's southern rim, heading towards Africa. Along its eventful voyage, this gigantic vessel of stone picked up a rich diversity of passengers from the surrounding land and sea.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: World's Deadliest
programme.desc: Our world is home to an array of wild creatures…creatures that have evolved to survive amid harsh environments, and brutal competition. But in every region resides an elite group of twelve species -- an assembly of mammals, reptiles, insects, and arachnids-- equipped with an arsenal of predatory and defensive skills. They're beautiful, they're highly evolved, and they're dangerous-they are the Deadly Dozen.

programme.title: Living Edens
programme.desc: Born of a violent explosion more than two million years ago, the Ngorongoro Crater is one of the true wonders of the world. Today the ancient crater is a microcosm of African life. The relentless daily cycle of life and death within the crater's grasslands, wetlands, lakes and forests maintains a delicate balance for the lions, hyenas, cheetahs, jackals, vultures, servals and wildebeest that live there.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons
programme.desc: TV series that captures the wildlife that lives within of Africa. A number of iconic species call the vast biodiversity in this country and help us to understand their natural behaviours in their habitats. Jack Spencer takes us on a journey to look at the amazing communities ranging from a pride of fearsome lions, to a herd of enormous elephants to the smaller insects and everything in between. Each episode has a main focus of one animal group or topic within Africa so for those who enjoy learning about Africa, this programme is for you.

programme.title: Statybų nesėkmės
programme.desc: Stiklas yra viena populiariausių statybinių medžiagų, bet dirbti su juo yra sunku ir pavojinga. Šioje serijoje tiriame mokslinę anomaliją - nikelio sulfitą stiklo sudėtyje ir jo poveikį.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine
programme.desc: It is pure luck to have a genie to fulfill all wishes, to have two of them is something incredible. Leah is a little girl with a genie bottle necklace, which includes Shimmer and Shine, genie twins. Shimmer is a genie with blue eyes and pink hair, encouraging and passionate, she has a pet, a gibbon monkey Tala. Shine is her twin genie with purple eyes and blue hair, big animal lover. Her pet is a little Bengal tiger Nahal. Zac is Leah's neighbor with red hair and blue eyes, and her best human friend. Leah is making three wishes every day, genies are doing their best but the results are far from perfect, as genies are very young and unskilled. This is the source of awkward and comic situations, but in the end girls manage to get over all difficulties.

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.desc: Rusty Rivets is a fantastic and picturesque animated series about Rusty who lives in Sparkton Hills along with his friend Ruby Ramirez, a robotic tyrannosaurid named Botasaur, and a group of smaller robots known as the Bits. Rusty is a smart inventor and a little genius who with the help of his amazing discoveries helps his friends out of difficulties. Rusty constructs robots of different sizes, forms and purposes, he is in love with science, technology and engineering. Together with his friend Ruby they can repair any old machinery and out-of-date equipment. Their splendid intellect arouses envy and toxic rivals do not play the game clean.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob SquarePants is a cartoon series starring the yellow sea sponge Spongebob who lives deep in the ocean in the underwater town called Bikini Bottom. Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: A prequel to SpongeBob SquarePants, featuring the beloved characters as children, spending their summertime at Camp Coral having fun doing typical camp activities like building campfires, catching jellyfish, and swimming in Lake Yuckymuck, causing a bit of trouble and chaos on the side. SpongeBob SquarePants is a ten-year-old with a red cap, goofy and friendly as he's always been. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: Harvey Beaks
programme.desc: Harvey Beaks is a good kid on a mission to have fun, and nothing can stand in his way! Well, except for the fact that he irons his bed sheets and is always on time. Will his best friends, Fee and Foo, be able to help Harvey tap into his wild side? From fighting a gang of squirrels to stealing bikes from Randl the grumpy raccoon, there are tons of adventures to be had in Bigbark Woods. Harvey, Fee and Foo are ready to cause some trouble and have a blast along the way.

programme.title: Wallykazam!
programme.desc: Wallykazam! follows the adventures of a troll named Wally and his pet dragon, Norville, who live in a forest with giants, goblins, ogres, sprites and other mythical creatures. Wally uses his magic stick to make words come to life on screen that start with a specific letter, sound or rhyme. Each episode features a new set of magic words that Wally uses to playfully transform the world around him.

programme.title: Winx Club
programme.desc: The Winx travel to Flora's home world, Lynphea, to visit the Specialists. When the Trix attack, the Winx attempt to fight back but they are stripped of all of their powers when they confront the Legendarium; except Bloom since her Dragon Flame cannot be extinguished. Bloom then shares her Dragon Flame with her friends so that they will earn a new transformation when they perform actions worthy of real fairies.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Best Foes: Kowalski invents an enemy detector. As is often the case, it doesn't work, and Skipper gets his own wires crossed when he smashes it. Old enemies are now friends and old friends are now enemies as the boss bird starts to systematically clean out the zoo with the help of his new friend Hans. King Julien gets into the act by becoming Skipper's friend too, going so far as to Congaga dance together. New BFF Hans is not happy with the new bromance, however. Could this be the opening the penguins need? Night of the Vesuviuses: The annual Zoo Snooze is here! Kids get to buy tickets for a zoo sleepover, a treat the animals look forward to every year! This year's going to be very different, however, when the rotten Vesuvius Twins buy up all the tickets themselves. The zoosters plan to turn the tables, though, and exact sweet revenge on the twins. The penguins, influenced by Private of course, can't let this happen, and it's a long night's journey into day as the penguins scramble to protect their one-time tormentors.

His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Spongicus: Plankton has demolished the Chum Bucket! No one in Bikini Bottom can resist, not even Mr. Krabs! Suction Cup Symphony: The Bikini Bottom Symphony is accepting submissions for their composition contest, and Squidward is determined to win. He immediately gets to work on his masterpiece, but when SpongeBob and Patrick keep disrupting Squidward's concentration, it looks like they might ruin his chance at musical stardom.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Not Normal: When Squidward points out to SpongeBob that he's not normal, SpongeBob makes it his mission to become normal. programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When Leonardo finds himself the accidental hero in a subway station, saving the lives of innocent bystanders, he's thrilled by the title of HERO. This pushes him to a life of crime-fighting vigilantism, starting with putting the Purple Dragons in their place. But when he's caught on camera and his brothers and April see this Turtle-shaped hero on the news, they interrogate him: what's he up to... and can they get in on it? Now, the four Night Ninjas and April suit up and set out to rid the streets of crime in a single night. Now what's left to do? April finds a dog-napping ring that's been snatching up purebreds. Baiting the dog-nappers with a fancy pooch, the Turtles track the criminals and meet the villainous French florist known as... La Fleur! She and her band of hench-florists are using the dog-napping as a cover-up for a much larger crime. And when the Night Ninjas show up to stop her, it may be too late for Leo and his brothers as the whole thing goes up in flames... literally.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

SpongeBob and Patrick decide to get tan so they can go to the party, but SpongeBob accidentally goes too far and turns sun-bleached white! Now, not only is he the wrong shade, but he can barely move without cracking and turning to dust.

programme.desc: In una realtà sospesa tra sogno e quotidiano, il film esplora i confini del sentimento più puro. Un viaggio onirico e poetico che mette a nudo la fragilità umana di fronte alla forza travolgente del destino.

programme.title: Chopin - Notturno A Parigi
programme.desc: Parigi, 1835. Il giovane Frédéric Chopin è il re dei salotti mondani, ma nasconde l'avanzare della tubercolosi. Il compositore ingaggia una drammatica corsa contro il tempo, trasformando il proprio declino e il dolore fisico in musica immortale.

programme.title: Troy
programme.desc: Brad Pitt, Eric Bana e Orlando Bloom nel kolossal ispirato al poema omerico. Dopo il rapimento di Elena da parte di Paride, Agamennone guida gli spartani contro i troiani.

programme.title: Anna
programme.desc: Action travolgente di Luc Besson con Cillian Murphy, Helen Mirren e Luke Evans. Intrappolata tra missioni e desiderio di libertà, una modella russa si trasforma in una spia letale.

programme.title: E poi si vede
programme.desc: Tre ragazzi competono per un posto di lavoro nell'ufficio legale del municipio. Federico conta sull'aiuto di suo padre, consigliere comunale, Fabrizio cerca un'altra opportunità e Luca, ragazzo privilegiato, si unisce alla corsa.

programme.title: Giorni di tuono
programme.desc: Action ad alta velocita' con Tom Cruise, Nicole Kidman e Robert Duvall. Dopo un incidente, un pilota automobilistico cerca di rimettersi in pista grazie all'aiuto di una bella neurologa.

programme.title: Le aquile della repubblica
programme.desc: Teso noir politico presentato in concorso a Cannes. Precipitato nel cuore oscuro del potere, Il più famoso attore egiziano sarà costretto a scendere a compromessi.

programme.title: Non succede, ma se succede...
programme.desc: Charlize Theron e Seth Rogen in un'irriverente commedia romantica. Un giornalista disoccupato si innamora della sua babysitter di un tempo, in corsa per la presidenza degli Stati Uniti.

programme.title: Il giorno sbagliato
programme.desc: Russell Crowe in un thriller psicologico dove la banalità del quotidiano degenera in pura follia. Una donna intrappolata nel traffico usa con troppa insistenza il clacson, scatenando gli impulsi rabbiosi di un autista psicopatico che da quel momento comincia a perseguitarla.

programme.title: Blacklight
programme.desc: Liam Neeson e Aidan Quinn in un action Sky Original. Un ex agente federale e una giornalista rischiano la vita per portare alla luce un complotto che coinvolge i vertici dell'FBI.

programme.title: E poi si vede

programme.title: L'ultima regina: Firebrand
programme.desc: Nell'Inghilterra dei Tudor, Katherine Parr accetta a malincuore di diventare la sesta moglie del tirannico re Enrico VIII. Considerata una minaccia, i cortigiani di Enrico iniziano a seminare dubbi sulla sua fedeltà e a mettere il re contro di lei.

programme.desc: Scatenata commedia romantica con Julia Roberts e Cameron Diaz rivali in amore. Una ragazza scopre di essere innamorata del suo miglior amico che sta per sposarsi e decide di sedurlo.

programme.desc: Caccia al serial killer con Al Pacino e Karl Urban. Due detective e una reporter sono sulle tracce di un assassino che uccide le sue vittime basandosi su un gioco per bambini.

programme.title: Benvenuti al Sud
programme.desc: Commedia campione d'incassi con Claudio Bisio e Alessandro Siani, remake di "Giù al Nord". Trasferito per punizione nel Cilento, un impiegato milanese sarà rapito dalla vitalità del posto.

programme.title: Operation Fortune
programme.desc: Action Sky Original di Guy Ritchie con Jason Statham e Hugh Grant. Una spia dell'MI6 e il suo team di agenti reclutano una star di Hollywood per una missione sotto copertura.

programme.title: Operazione vendetta
programme.desc: Avvincente action movie basato su un romanzo di Robert Littell, con Rami Malek che veste i panni di un crittografo della CIA. L'uomo decide di vendicarsi personalmente dei terroristi che hanno ucciso sua moglie.

programme.title: Il matrimonio del mio migliore amico
programme.desc: Scatenata commedia romantica con Julia Roberts e Cameron Diaz rivali in amore. Una ragazza scopre di essere innamorata del suo miglior amico che sta per sposarsi e decide di sedurlo.

programme.title: Barry Lyndon
programme.desc: 4 Oscar al capolavoro di Stanley Kubrick con Ryan O'Neal e Marisa Berenson. L'Irlanda del '700 fa da sfondo alla parabola di Redmond Barry, fra duelli d'amore e carriera militare.

programme.title: Le Déluge: Gli ultimi giorni di Maria Antonietta
programme.desc: Gianluca Jodice dirige una pellicola, premiata con 4 David e 2 Nastri d'Argento, che indaga le psicologie di Luigi XVI (Guillaume Canet) e Maria Antonietta (Melanie Laurent).

programme.title: Le ali della libertà
programme.desc: Tim Robbins e Morgan Freeman nel dramma carcerario tratto da Stephen King. Mentre sogna la fuga, un bancario condannato per omicidio stringe una grande amicizia con un altro detenuto.

programme.title: What They Had
programme.desc: Hilary Swank e Michael Shannon in un dramma familiare. Tornata nella casa di Chicago per gestire la malattia della madre, Bridget è costretta a fare i conti con rancori mai sopiti.

programme.title: Eden
programme.desc: Diretto da Ron Howard, un avvincente thriller basato su una storia vera con Jude Law e Vanessa Kirby. Dopo la crisi del 1929, il dottore e filosofo Friedrich Ritter decide di lasciare la Germania e di trasferirsi in un'isola remota delle Galapagos.

programme.title: La verità secondo Maureen K.
programme.desc: Pellicola biografica con Isabelle Huppert protagonista. Maureen Kernay, sindacalista in un'azienda leader nel campo nucleare, scopre un segreto che potrebbe sconvolgere l'intera nazione.

programme.title: Interstellar
programme.desc: Oscar agli effetti speciali per il kolossal sci-fi di Christopher Nolan con un cast stellare. Un gruppo di astronauti sfrutta un varco spazio-temporale per trovare nuovi pianeti.

programme.title: Sotto attacco
programme.desc: Stephen Dorff sale sul ring in un action-drama dallo sceneggiatore di "American History X". Diventato campione di MMA come reazione a un padre violento, Cash si ritrova a gestire un figlio che vuole seguire le sue orme e la nascita di un bambino affetto da una rara sindrome.

programme.title: Fuga per la vittoria
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone, Michael Caine e Pele' nel cult di John Huston. I prigionieri di un lager sfidano i soldati nazisti in una partita di calcio sperando di approfittarne per evadere.

programme.title: Coda - I segni del cuore
programme.desc: 3 premi Oscar 2022 al remake di Sian Heder premiato al Sundance. Ruby, unica udente in una famiglia di sordomuti, sogna un futuro nel canto ma non vuole lasciare i suoi cari.

programme.title: Adagio
programme.desc: Pierfrancesco Favino, Toni Servillo, Valerio Mastandrea e Adriano Giannini nel noir di Stefano Sollima. Il declino inesorabile e struggente di tre vecchie leggende della Roma criminale.

programme.title: The Last Rifleman - Ritorno in Normandia
programme.desc: Pellicola Sky Original con Pierce Brosnan protagonista. Un veterano della Seconda guerra mondiale fugge dalla casa di cura per partecipare al 75 anniversario dello sbarco in Normandia.

programme.title: We Are Marshall
programme.desc: Dal regista di "Charlie's Angels", un'emozionante storia vera con Matthew McConaughey. Dopo un tragico incidente, un allenatore fa di tutto per ricostruire la squadra di football.

programme.title: Sotto attacco
programme.desc: Stephen Dorff sale sul ring in un action-drama dallo sceneggiatore di "American History X". Diventato campione di MMA come reazione a un padre violento, Cash si ritrova a gestire un figlio che vuole seguire le sue orme e la nascita di un bambino affetto da una rara sindrome.

programme.title: Il ritratto del Duca
programme.desc: Commedia biografica con Jim Broadbent, Helen Mirren e Matthew Goode. Londra: un tassista ruba un prezioso quadro dalla National Gallery e chiede al governo un riscatto inconsueto.

programme.title: Kursk
programme.desc: Thomas Vinterberg ricostruisce la storia vera del sottomarino russo affondato nel mare di Barents nell'estate del 2000. Con Léa Seydoux, Colin Firth, Matthias Schoenaerts e Max von Sydow.

programme.title: War - La guerra desiderata
programme.desc: War-dramedy di Gianni Zanasi con Edoardo Leo, Miriam Leone, Giuseppe Battiston. La guerra tra Italia e Spagna unisce le vite di un allevatore di vongole e della figlia di un politico.

programme.title: Il quadro rubato
programme.desc: André Masson, esperto di arte moderna, riceve una lettera in cui si dice che un dipinto di Egon Schiele è stato trovato a Mulhouse. Dell'opera era scomparsa ogni traccia ormai dal 1939.

programme.title: Adagio
programme.desc: Pierfrancesco Favino, Toni Servillo, Valerio Mastandrea e Adriano Giannini nel noir di Stefano Sollima. Il declino inesorabile e struggente di tre vecchie leggende della Roma criminale.

programme.title: I figli degli uomini
programme.desc: Sci-Fi distopico di Alfonso Cuaron, con Clive Owen, Julianne Moore e Michael Caine. 2027: un ex attivista protegge l'unica donna rimasta incinta in un'umanita' colpita dall'infertilita'.

programme.title: Una notte a New York
programme.desc: Dakota Johnson e Sean Penn instaurano una connessione profonda in un film di rivelazioni e complicità, opera prima di Christy Hall. La conversazione fra una donna e un tassista nel tragitto dall'aeroporto JFK e Manhattan diventa un lungo dialogo sulle loro emozioni più intime.

programme.title: Il Concorso
programme.desc: Keira Knightley e Gugu Mbatha-Raw nel biopic su una storica battaglia femminista. Londra, 1970: il ‘Women's Liberation Movement’ irrompe in diretta televisiva durante il concorso per l’elezione di Miss Mondo in segno di protesta contro la strumentalizzazione delle donne.

programme.title: Hometown - La strada dei ricordi
programme.desc: Un documentario biografico basato sui ricordi di due artisti famosi. Il regista Roman Polanski e il fotografo Ryszard Horowitz tornano insieme in Polonia dopo 60 anni, e tra le strade di Cracovia ripercorrono l'infanzia e la giovinezza segnate dalla Shoah.

programme.title: Il ritorno di Casanova
programme.desc: Toni Servillo e Fabrizio Bentivoglio nel film di Gabriele Salvatores, dal romanzo di Arthur Schnitzler. Un maturo regista lotta con le sue nevrosi mentre lavora a un biopic su Casanova.

programme.title: Italia 1982 - Una storia azzurra
programme.desc: Il documentario che ripercorre il trionfo della nazionale italiana di calcio al Mundial spagnolo: una vittoria indelebile che ha ispirato una generazione e riunito un'intera nazione.

programme.title: Il capo perfetto
programme.desc: Javier Bardem in una dark comedy sul mondo del lavoro premiatissima in Spagna. Il padrone di un'azienda e' disposto a tutto pur di vincere un importante premio.

programme.title: Lee Miller
programme.desc: Racconto intenso sulla vita della fotografa Lee Miller, che esplora il costo emotivo del suo lavoro e il coraggio necessario per documentare la realtà brutale della guerra.

programme.title: Adagio
programme.desc: Pierfrancesco Favino, Toni Servillo, Valerio Mastandrea e Adriano Giannini nel noir di Stefano Sollima. Il declino inesorabile e struggente di tre vecchie leggende della Roma criminale.
3 Oscar al capolavoro bellico di Sam Mendes con George MacKay e un grande cast. Due soldati inglesi sono incaricati di portare in territorio nemico un messaggio che salverebbe molte vite.

programme.title: L'ora più buia
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Gary Oldman nel film che racconta i primi turbolenti giorni da Primo Ministro di Winston Churchill. Nel 1940, il celebre statista inglese deve affrontare l'avanzata dei nazisti e prendere decisioni drammatiche per il bene del suo paese, ma deve fare i conti con lo scettico re e con alcuni membri del suo partito che sembrano tramare contro di lui. Oscar anche al trucco. La pellicola è stato candidata anche per la sceneggiatura, scritta da Anthony McCarten che aveva firmato anche un altro fortunato biopic, “La teoria del tutto”.

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: 3 Oscar al War Movie di Christopher Nolan che ripercorre la storica Operazione Dynamo. 1940: la difesa degli inglesi, attaccati dai nazisti, viene narrata da un triplice punto di vista.

programme.title: Il ritorno di Casanova
programme.desc: Toni Servillo e Fabrizio Bentivoglio nel film di Gabriele Salvatores, dal romanzo di Arthur Schnitzler. Un maturo regista lotta con le sue nevrosi mentre lavora a un biopic su Casanova.

programme.title: L'orchestra stonata
programme.desc: Thibaut è un direttore d'orchestra di fama internazionale che viaggia per il mondo. Quando scopre di essere stato adottato, scopre di avere un fratello che lavora in una mensa e suona il trombone in una banda di ottoni nel nord della Francia.

programme.title: Duel
programme.desc: David Mann, tranquillo commesso, si ritrova imprigionato in un pericoloso gioco al gatto e al topo in autostrada con un mostruoso camion guidato da un misterioso psicopatico.

programme.title: Benvenuti a Marwen
programme.desc: Il premio Oscar Robert Zemeckis dirige Steve Carell nella toccante biografia di Mark Hogancamp. Rimasto invalido e senza memoria dopo un pestaggio, lo sfortunato artista trova la forza di andare avanti e la speranza di guarire costruendo una citta' di bambole nel suo giardino, all'interno della quale ricrea avventure basate sui fatti della propria vita con protagonista il suo alter ego, Hogie. Una creazione artistica che diventa per Mark la chiave per entrare in un mondo di fantasia. La storia di Mark Hogancamp e' al centro anche del documentario "Marwencol' di Jeff Malmberg.

programme.title: Potere assoluto
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige e interpreta, al fianco di Gene Hackman, un thriller da antologia. Luther Whitney è un vero artista del furto, nessuna cassaforte o serratura può resistergli, ma ormai sta diventando anziano e ha deciso di ritirarsi dopo un ultimo colpo. Deve però fare i conti con un imprevisto perché la padrona della casa che Luther ha deciso di svaligiare non è partita con il marito, per intrattenersi con il suo amante che non è altri che il Presidente degli Stati Uniti. Quando la donna muore, la polizia prova a insabbiare il caso, ma per farlo occorre far tacere l'unico testimone. Eastwood e Hackman di nuovo uno contro l'altro, come ne "Gli spietati".

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova ci raccontano alcune delle migliori pellicole del regista sudcoreano, disponibili su Sky Cinema e On Demand.

programme.title: La Verita' Negata
programme.desc: Jack O' Connell e Laura Dern nel biopic che ritorna su un controverso caso giuridico. Texas, 7 febbraio 2004: dopo dodici anni nel braccio della morte, Cameron Todd Willingham viene giustiziato per aver appiccato volontariamente l’incendio che ha provocato la morte delle tre figlie. Una sentenza arrivata al termine di un processo pieno di contraddizioni e punti oscuri. Diretto dal produttore di “Shakespeare in Love”, Edward Zwick. Scritto da Geoffrey Fletcher, entrato nella storia come primo afroamericano a vincere l’Oscar per la miglior sceneggiatura non originale con “Precious” nel 2010.

programme.title: Il colore della libertà
programme.desc: Biopic prodotto da Spike Lee. 1961: Bob Zellner, studente universitario dell'Alabama e nipote di un membro del Ku Klux Klan, decide di schierarsi in difesa dei diritti degli afroamericani.

programme.title: Quella sporca ultima meta
programme.desc: Burt Reynolds nel classico del genere carcerario di Robert Aldrich. In prigione per guida in stato di ebbrezza, un ex campione di rugby viene costretto ad allenare una squadra di detenuti.

programme.title: Radioactive
programme.desc: Rosamund Pike, Sam Riley e Anya Taylor-Joy nella biografia di Marie Curie. La vita della scienziata polacca, naturalizzata francese, che ha cambiato il mondo con le sue scoperte, salendo in cattedra in una società dominata dagli uomini e aggiudicandosi per due volte il Nobel.

programme.title: Il ritorno di Casanova
programme.desc: Toni Servillo e Fabrizio Bentivoglio nel film di Gabriele Salvatores, dal romanzo di Arthur Schnitzler. Un maturo regista lotta con le sue nevrosi mentre lavora a un biopic su Casanova.

programme.title: Il miglio verde
programme.desc: Tom Hanks nel dramma carcerario tratto dal romanzo di Stephen King. 1935: un gigantesco uomo di colore, dotato di poteri curativi, viene condannato a morte per omicidio.

programme.title: Emily
programme.desc: Frances O'Connor esordisce alla regia con il biopic sull'autrice di 'Cime tempestose', interpretata da Emma Mackey. L’equilibrio della famiglia Bronte è scosso dall’arrivo del nuovo Pastore.

programme.title: L'infiltrata
programme.desc: Guadagnandosi la fiducia dei membri dell'ETA, una poliziotta raccoglie informazioni cruciali per i servizi segreti spagnoli. Mentre la polizia prepara un'operazione su vasta scala, lei deve portare avanti la sua missione senza destare sospetti.

programme.title: Barry Seal - Una storia americana
programme.desc: Tom Cruise e Domhnall Gleeson in un action tratto da una storia vera. Un pilota accusato di narcotraffico viene reclutato dalla Cia per svolgere missioni sotto copertura in Centro America.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Ron Howard dirige Chris Hemsworth e Daniel Bruhl nel biopic sulla rivalita' fra i piloti James Hunt e Niki Lauda, protagonisti di una memorabile stagione della Formula Uno.

programme.title: Il cavaliere elettrico
programme.desc: Cult anni 70 di Sydney Pollack con Robert Redford e Jane Fonda. Un campione di rodeo ruba un cavallo e fugge verso le montagne, inseguito da una giornalista in cerca di scoop.

programme.title: Ore 15:17 - Attacco al treno
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood affronta la piaga del terrorismo dirigendo un dramma tratto da una storia vera, interpretata dagli eroi che l'hanno realmente vissuta. Spencer Stone, Alek Skarlatos e Anthony Sadler sono tre ragazzi di Sacramento, amici di lunga data, che stanno passando le vacanze in giro per l'Europa. E il 21 agosto del 2015 si trovano a bordo del treno Thalys 9364 diretto da Amsterdam a Parigi. Il treno, con a bordo circa 500 passeggeri, è anche l'obiettivo dell'Isis, ma saranno proprio Spencer, Alek e Anthony a sventare l'attentato, trasformandosi da persone comuni a eroi.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Un due tre stella!
programme.desc: Nona commedia targata Sky con vecchi e nuovi personaggi (Stefano Fresi, Corrado Guzzanti). Il ritrovamento di un cadavere e la scomparsa di Viviani scuotono la comunita' di Pineta.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - La battaglia navale
programme.desc: La decima storia tratta dal romanzo di Marco Malvaldi ci riporta a Pineta. Il ritrovamento del cadavere di una donna al largo della baia di Calaluna da' il via alle indagini.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Il battesimo di Ampelio
programme.desc: Undicesimo film targato Sky tratto dal mondo dei romanzi di Marco Malvaldi. Il neoarrivato Beppe e il commissario Fusco indagano sulla misteriosa morte di un prete.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Hasta pronto Viviani
programme.desc: Dodicesima commedia targata Sky, tratta dal mondo dei romanzi di Marco Malvaldi, con Filippo Timi. Mentre Massimo e' sparito in Argentina, l'omicidio di un latitante sconvolge Pineta.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Donne con le palle
programme.desc: Tra campionati di beach volley, cervi in fuga e giri di scommesse clandestine i nostri protagonisti del BarLume si troveranno a indagare sull’ennesimo misterioso omicidio.

programme.title: I Delitti Del Barlume - Ritorno A Pineta
programme.desc: A rompere la tranquillita' della stagione estiva di Pineta questa volta e' l'inaspettato ritorno di uno dei suoi cittadini piu' amati: il Viviani del BarLume.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume-Mare forza quattro
programme.desc: Tornano i personaggi di Pineta nel 15esimo film della produzione Sky Original. Una forte mareggiata di fine marzo riporta un cadavere proprio sotto al BarLume.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Tana libera tutti
programme.desc: Sedicesimo film della saga Sky Original con Filippo Timi e Lucia Mascino. Una misteriosa scomparsa mette in subbuglio il Pasquali e i vecchini, chiusi in casa per il lockdown.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Compro oro

programme.title: Bud Spencer & Terence Hill
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano a colpi di film iconici del leggendario duo, disponibili su Sky Cinema e Sky On Demand.

programme.title: The Portable Door
programme.desc: Dai libri fantasy di Tom Hol, film Sky Original con Christoph Waltz, Sam Neill e Patrick Gibson. Londra: due tirocinanti scoprono che i loro capi vogliono sabotare il mondo della magia.

programme.title: Stardust
programme.desc: Avventurosa fiaba fantasy con Michelle Pfeiffer, Charlie Cox e Robert De Niro. Un ragazzo entra in un regno magico per catturare la stella cadente che ha promesso alla sua amata.

programme.title: Viaggio al centro della Terra
programme.desc: Brendan Fraser nel remake di un classico degli anni 50. Tre esploratori si inoltrano sotto la superficie terrestre alla scoperta di un regno sconosciuto, abitato da minacciose creature.

programme.title: Cattivissimo me 3
programme.desc: Terzo successo al box office per i personaggi targati Illumination. Mentre i Minions si dimettono, Gru scopre di avere un fratello gemello, Dru. Insieme daranno la caccia a Balthazar Bratt.

programme.title: La strada per El Dorado
programme.desc: Viaggio nel Nuovo Mondo in una pellicola di animazione targata Dreamworks. 1519: fuggiti da un galeone spagnolo, due imbroglioni cercano il leggendario tesoro della città di El Dorado.

programme.title: Tutti per Uma
programme.desc: Commedia con Pietro Sermonti, Pasquale "Lillo" Petrolo e Antonio Catania. L'arrivo della principessa Uma risolleva le sorti dell'azienda vinicola dei Ferliga, una famiglia di soli maschi.

programme.title: Willy Wonka e la fabbrica di cioccolato
programme.desc: Gene Wilder in un inno alla fantasia, dal romanzo di Roald Dahl. Lo stravagante Willy Wonka accompagna cinque bambini in un tour all'interno della sua inaccessibile fabbrica di dolciumi.

programme.title: Z La formica
programme.desc: Spettacolari avventure in un gioiello d'animazione della Dreamworks. Per fare colpo sulla Principessa Bala, Z si finge formica-soldato e si trova coinvolto nella guerra contro le termiti.

programme.title: Il cacciatore di giganti
programme.desc: Il regista di "X-Men" spalanca la porta di un mondo fantasy. Grazie a dei fagioli magici, il giovane contadino Jack si ritrova in un regno abitato da mostri giganteschi che vogliono conquistare la Terra, come accaduto tanti secoli prima quando l’intero pianeta era sotto il loro dominio. Quando i giganti, guidati dal perfido Fallon, rapiscono la principessa Isabelle, Jack non esita a unirsi alla truppe che dovranno liberarla, ponendo fine una volta per sempre all'atavica guerra. Spinto dall'amore, supererà le sue paure scoprendo doti e virtù nascoste.

programme.title: Moon il panda
programme.desc: Gilles de Maistre firma un inno alla bellezza della natura e all'amicizia tra uomo e animale. Cina: lo svogliato dodicenne Tian, sempre distratto dai videogame, viene mandato dalla nonna sulle montagne del Sichuan dove stringe un legame profondo con un cucciolo di panda.

programme.title: Il gatto con gli stivali
programme.desc: Il celebre felino e' il protagonista dello spin-off della saga di Shrek. Dopo una rapina finita male, l'amicizia fra Gatto e Humpty Dumpty si e' rotta, ma il destino li fara' rincontrare.

programme.desc: Animazione Sky Original dal romanzo di Terry Pratchett. L'astuto gatto Maurice coinvolge nel suo piano truffaldino una banda di topi parlanti e il giovane pifferaio Keith.

programme.desc: Robin Williams, Dustin Hoffman e Julia Roberts in un film di Steven Spielberg. Peter, ormai adulto, deve tornare sull’Isola che non c'e' per ritrovare i suoi figli, rapiti da Capitan Uncino.
